properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-08-22 through the shipped binary, on both arms of the original trial, immediately after `vocabulary_coverage` began NAMING the properties it had only ever counted.

                       before   after   growth
  mature (2897 nodes)      31      70     +39  (+126%)
  day-one (2 nodes)        88     101     +13  (+15%)

⭐ THE ASYMMETRY IS THE POINT, AND IT IS THE ANSWER TO THE OBJECTION THIS CHANGE HAD TO CLEAR. The trial's fourth decision withheld the flat list because it was LONGEST FOR THE USER LEAST ABLE TO ACT ON IT — 88 items on day one against 31 on a mature design. Naming properties could only have made that worse; instead it narrowed the gap from 57 items to 31, because the vacuous-zero rule suppresses every property of every type that has no instances, and on day one almost no type has any. The list grows where somebody can act on it and barely moves where they cannot.

The DEFAULT reply, which is what every caller pays for, grew from about 2.4 KB to 2973 bytes on the day-one arm — one `properties` figure per domain, eleven numbers, never a list.

WHAT THE MATURE ARM FOUND ON REFLOW2 ITSELF, none of which any shipped report could state before:
  `Artifact.audience` — 0 of 190. reflow2 added the field in #295 so that a deliverable declares who it reaches, and has classified NOT ONE OF ITS OWN. That is `rule:the-self-host-always-trails-what-it-teaches` again, and it is now visible rather than inferred.
  22 EDGE properties on edge types that have edges: `ALLOCATED_TO.{weight,frequency,data_volume,note}`, `PROVIDES.{weight,frequency,data_volume}`, `CONSUMES.{frequency,data_volume}` — the entire coupling vocabulary the structural detectors read, declared and never once written. `TRIGGERS.{confidence,evidence}`, `BLOCKS.confidence`, `RISKS.confidence`, `EVOLVES_INTO.confidence`, `VERIFIES.coverage`, `CONTAINS.note`, `ASKS_ABOUT.note`.
  `Project.mirror_*` (4), `Fragment.{summary,intent,phase,created_by,created_at}`, `Snapshot.captured_at`, `Release.created_at`, `Artifact.created_at`, `Project.created_at` — the never-set timestamp cluster, still there.
  `Constraint.{objective,rationale}`, `Requirement.source`, `Question.prompt_id`, `Verification.location`, `Environment.description`, `Artifact.{description,signature}`.

⚠️ WHAT THE FIGURES ARE NOT. `properties_on_used_types` reads 155 of 178 and `properties_on_used_edge_types` 59 of 81, and NEITHER counts a property that carries a schema DEFAULT as capable of being unused — the store materialises defaults on write, so every instance carries one. What is named is the UNDEFAULTED optional. That is the class that matters (`req:defaults-do-not-assert` is why the fields worth asking about have no default) but it means these figures are an UNDER-count of vocabulary nobody chose, not a full one.
